CHECK ((phase IN ('prepared', 'applying') AND committed_repository_revision IS NULL) OR (phase IN ('committed', 'finalizing', 'completed') AND committed_repository_revision >= 0))

data.name: operation_records

CHECK (source_lineage_id IS NOT NULL OR (before_object_id IS NULL AND after_object_id IS NULL))

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workspace_metadata" ("singleton" INTEGER NOT NULL, "repository_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "destruction_epoch" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at_micros" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_micros" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("singleton"), CHECK (singleton = 1), CHECK (repository_revision >= 0), CHECK (destruction_epoch >= 0), CHECK (created_at_micros >= 0), CHECK (updated_at_micros >= created_at_micros));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "source_lineages" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "managed_skill_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES managed_skills (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "object_format" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_micros" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("managed_skill_id", "id"), CHECK (length(id) = 36 AND lower(id) = id AND substr(id, 15, 1) = '4' AND substr(id, 20, 1) IN ('8', '9', 'a', 'b') AND substr(id, 9, 1) = '-' AND substr(id, 14, 1) = '-' AND substr(id, 19, 1) = '-' AND substr(id, 24, 1) = '-' AND id NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f-]*'), CHECK (length(managed_skill_id) = 36 AND lower(managed_skill_id) = managed_skill_id AND substr(managed_skill_id, 15, 1) = '4' AND substr(managed_skill_id, 20, 1) IN ('8', '9', 'a', 'b') AND substr(managed_skill_id, 9, 1) = '-' AND substr(managed_skill_id, 14, 1) = '-' AND substr(managed_skill_id, 19, 1) = '-' AND substr(managed_skill_id, 24, 1) = '-' AND managed_skill_id NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f-]*'), CHECK (object_format IN ('sha1', 'sha256')), CHECK (created_at_micros >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "managed_skills" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "slot_key" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "declared_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL, "active_source_lineage_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_micros" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_micros" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (length(id) = 36 AND lower(id) = id AND substr(id, 15, 1) = '4' AND substr(id, 20, 1) IN ('8', '9', 'a', 'b') AND substr(id, 9, 1) = '-' AND substr(id, 14, 1) = '-' AND substr(id, 19, 1) = '-' AND substr(id, 24, 1) = '-' AND id NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f-]*'), CHECK (length(trim(slot_key)) > 0), CHECK (length(trim(declared_name)) > 0), CHECK (length(trim(display_name)) > 0), CHECK (length(trim(description)) > 0), CHECK (created_at_micros >= 0), CHECK (updated_at_micros >= created_at_micros), FOREIGN KEY (id, active_source_lineage_id) REFERENCES source_lineages(managed_skill_id, id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "skill_sources" ("source_lineage_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES source_lineages (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload_schema_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "payload_json" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("source_lineage_id"), CHECK (kind IN ('local', 'git', 'wellKnown', 'adoptedSnapshot')), CHECK (payload_schema_version = 1), CHECK (json_valid(payload_json)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "revision_metadata" ("source_lineage_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES source_lineages (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "object_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "content_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "file_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "byte_size" INTEGER NOT NULL, "declared_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "validation_state" TEXT NOT NULL, "validation_code" TEXT NULL, "created_at_micros" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("source_lineage_id", "object_id"), CHECK (length(trim(object_id)) > 0), CHECK (length(content_hash) = 64 AND lower(content_hash) = content_hash AND content_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), CHECK (file_count >= 0), CHECK (byte_size >= 0), CHECK (length(trim(declared_name)) > 0), CHECK (validation_state IN ('valid', 'invalid')), CHECK ((validation_state = 'valid' AND validation_code IS NULL) OR (validation_state = 'invalid' AND length(trim(validation_code)) > 0)), CHECK (created_at_micros >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "current_revision_selection" ("managed_skill_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES managed_skills (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "source_lineage_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "upstream_object_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "effective_object_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("managed_skill_id"), FOREIGN KEY (managed_skill_id, source_lineage_id) REFERENCES source_lineages(managed_skill_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, FOREIGN KEY (source_lineage_id, upstream_object_id) REFERENCES revision_metadata(source_lineage_id, object_id) ON DELETE CASCADE DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, FOREIGN KEY (source_lineage_id, effective_object_id) REFERENCES revision_metadata(source_lineage_id, object_id) ON DELETE CASCADE DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "draft_workspaces" ("managed_skill_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES managed_skills (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "source_lineage_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "base_object_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "purpose" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_micros" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_micros" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("managed_skill_id"), CHECK (purpose IN ('customization', 'updateCandidateResolution')), CHECK (created_at_micros >= 0), CHECK (updated_at_micros >= created_at_micros), FOREIGN KEY (managed_skill_id, source_lineage_id) REFERENCES source_lineages(managed_skill_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, FOREIGN KEY (source_lineage_id, base_object_id) REFERENCES revision_metadata(source_lineage_id, object_id) ON DELETE CASCADE DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "update_candidate_sessions" ("managed_skill_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES managed_skills (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "source_lineage_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "previous_upstream_object_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "previous_effective_object_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "incoming_upstream_object_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "candidate_object_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "validation_code" TEXT NULL, "created_at_micros" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_micros" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("managed_skill_id"), CHECK (status IN ('conflicted', 'validationFailed')), CHECK ((status = 'conflicted' AND validation_code IS NULL) OR (status = 'validationFailed' AND length(trim(validation_code)) > 0)), CHECK (length(trim(candidate_object_id)) > 0), CHECK (created_at_micros >= 0), CHECK (updated_at_micros >= created_at_micros), FOREIGN KEY (managed_skill_id, source_lineage_id) REFERENCES source_lineages(managed_skill_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, FOREIGN KEY (source_lineage_id, previous_upstream_object_id) REFERENCES revision_metadata(source_lineage_id, object_id) ON DELETE CASCADE DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, FOREIGN KEY (source_lineage_id, previous_effective_object_id) REFERENCES revision_metadata(source_lineage_id, object_id) ON DELETE CASCADE DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, FOREIGN KEY (source_lineage_id, incoming_upstream_object_id) REFERENCES revision_metadata(source_lineage_id, object_id) ON DELETE CASCADE DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "update_candidate_items" ("managed_skill_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "path" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "base_object_id" TEXT NULL, "ours_object_id" TEXT NULL, "theirs_object_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("managed_skill_id", "path"), FOREIGN KEY (managed_skill_id) REFERENCES update_candidate_sessions(managed_skill_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, CHECK (length(trim(path)) > 0), CHECK (kind IN ('text', 'rename', 'deleteModify', 'binary', 'executableMode')), CHECK (state IN ('unresolved', 'resolved')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "project_roots" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "canonical_path" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "created_at_micros" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_micros" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (length(trim(id)) > 0), CHECK (length(trim(canonical_path)) > 0), CHECK (created_at_micros >= 0), CHECK (updated_at_micros >= created_at_micros));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "activation_locations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "managed_skill_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES managed_skills (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "canonical_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "scope" TEXT NOT NULL, "mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "project_root_id" TEXT NULL, "project_root_path" TEXT NULL, "created_at_micros" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("managed_skill_id", "canonical_path"), CHECK (length(id) = 36 AND lower(id) = id AND substr(id, 15, 1) = '4' AND substr(id, 20, 1) IN ('8', '9', 'a', 'b') AND substr(id, 9, 1) = '-' AND substr(id, 14, 1) = '-' AND substr(id, 19, 1) = '-' AND substr(id, 24, 1) = '-' AND id NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f-]*'), CHECK (scope IN ('global', 'project')), CHECK (mode IN ('copy', 'symbolicLink')), CHECK ((scope = 'global' AND project_root_id IS NULL AND project_root_path IS NULL) OR (scope = 'project' AND length(trim(project_root_id)) > 0 AND length(trim(project_root_path)) > 0)), CHECK (created_at_micros >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "activation_agents" ("activation_location_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES activation_locations (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "agent_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("activation_location_id", "agent_id"), CHECK (length(trim(agent_id)) > 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "skill_user_data" ("managed_skill_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES managed_skills (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "favorite" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("favorite" IN (0, 1)), "favorite_changed_at_micros" INTEGER NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "note_updated_at_micros" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("managed_skill_id"), CHECK ((favorite = 0 AND favorite_changed_at_micros IS NULL) OR (favorite = 1 AND favorite_changed_at_micros >= 0)), CHECK ((note IS NULL AND note_updated_at_micros IS NULL) OR (length(trim(note)) > 0 AND note_updated_at_micros >= 0)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "personal_tags" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "normalized_key" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "display_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "color" TEXT NULL, "created_at_micros" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_micros" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (length(id) = 36 AND lower(id) = id AND substr(id, 15, 1) = '4' AND substr(id, 20, 1) IN ('8', '9', 'a', 'b') AND substr(id, 9, 1) = '-' AND substr(id, 14, 1) = '-' AND substr(id, 19, 1) = '-' AND substr(id, 24, 1) = '-' AND id NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f-]*'), CHECK (length(trim(normalized_key)) > 0), CHECK (length(trim(display_name)) > 0), CHECK (color IS NULL OR (length(color) = 7 AND substr(color, 1, 1) = '#')), CHECK (created_at_micros >= 0), CHECK (updated_at_micros >= created_at_micros));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "skill_tag_assignments" ("managed_skill_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES managed_skills (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "personal_tag_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES personal_tags (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "created_at_micros" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("managed_skill_id", "personal_tag_id"), CHECK (created_at_micros >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "operation_journals" ("operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "phase" TEXT NOT NULL, "plan_schema_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "plan_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "operation_generation" INTEGER NOT NULL, "committed_repository_revision" INTEGER NULL, "started_at_micros" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_micros" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("operation_id"), CHECK (length(operation_id) = 36 AND lower(operation_id) = operation_id AND substr(operation_id, 15, 1) = '4' AND substr(operation_id, 20, 1) IN ('8', '9', 'a', 'b') AND substr(operation_id, 9, 1) = '-' AND substr(operation_id, 14, 1) = '-' AND substr(operation_id, 19, 1) = '-' AND substr(operation_id, 24, 1) = '-' AND operation_id NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f-]*'), CHECK (length(trim(kind)) > 0), CHECK (phase IN ('prepared', 'applying', 'committed', 'finalizing', 'completed')), CHECK (plan_schema_version >= 1), CHECK (json_valid(plan_json)), CHECK (operation_generation >= 1), CHECK ((phase IN ('prepared', 'applying') AND committed_repository_revision IS NULL) OR (phase IN ('committed', 'finalizing', 'completed') AND committed_repository_revision >= 0)), CHECK (started_at_micros >= 0), CHECK (updated_at_micros >= started_at_micros));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "operation_journal_steps" ("operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES operation_journals (operation_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "sequence" INTEGER NOT NULL, "step_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "recovery_reference" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("operation_id", "sequence"), UNIQUE ("operation_id", "step_id"), CHECK (sequence >= 0), CHECK (length(trim(step_id)) > 0), CHECK (length(trim(kind)) > 0), CHECK (status IN ('planned', 'started', 'completed')), CHECK (length(trim(recovery_reference)) > 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "operation_records" ("operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "retain_without_subjects" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("retain_without_subjects" IN (0, 1)), "started_at_micros" INTEGER NOT NULL, "completed_at_micros" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("operation_id"), CHECK (length(operation_id) = 36 AND lower(operation_id) = operation_id AND substr(operation_id, 15, 1) = '4' AND substr(operation_id, 20, 1) IN ('8', '9', 'a', 'b') AND substr(operation_id, 9, 1) = '-' AND substr(operation_id, 14, 1) = '-' AND substr(operation_id, 19, 1) = '-' AND substr(operation_id, 24, 1) = '-' AND operation_id NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f-]*'), CHECK (length(trim(kind)) > 0), CHECK (status IN ('succeeded', 'failed', 'cancelled')), CHECK (started_at_micros >= 0), CHECK (completed_at_micros >= started_at_micros));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "operation_subjects" ("subject_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES operation_records (operation_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "managed_skill_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES managed_skills (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "source_lineage_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES source_lineages (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "before_object_id" TEXT NULL, "after_object_id" TEXT NULL, "before_content_hash" TEXT NULL, "after_content_hash" TEXT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("subject_id"), UNIQUE ("operation_id", "managed_skill_id"), CHECK (length(subject_id) = 36 AND lower(subject_id) = subject_id AND substr(subject_id, 15, 1) = '4' AND substr(subject_id, 20, 1) IN ('8', '9', 'a', 'b') AND substr(subject_id, 9, 1) = '-' AND substr(subject_id, 14, 1) = '-' AND substr(subject_id, 19, 1) = '-' AND substr(subject_id, 24, 1) = '-' AND subject_id NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f-]*'), CHECK (length(trim(display_name)) > 0), CHECK (source_lineage_id IS NOT NULL OR (before_object_id IS NULL AND after_object_id IS NULL)), FOREIGN KEY (managed_skill_id, source_lineage_id) REFERENCES source_lineages(managed_skill_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, CHECK (before_content_hash IS NULL OR (length(before_content_hash) = 64 AND lower(before_content_hash) = before_content_hash AND before_content_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')), CHECK (after_content_hash IS NULL OR (length(after_content_hash) = 64 AND lower(after_content_hash) = after_content_hash AND after_content_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')));
